## Contract

- [ ] Chapter text and the tests describe the same behavior.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_version.py` passes.
- [ ] Stubs stay red. `AGENTSTACK_PEEK=1 pytest` stays green.
- [ ] A version bump updates `VERSION`, `agentstack/_version.py`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `CITATION.cff`, and the README badge together.
